Requirement_Title: Establish one versioned entity and product context
Job_to_Be_Done: Establish one versioned entity and product context
Current_Problem: Scope changes can invalidate downstream work
Product_Behaviour: The product shall retain the legal entity, product and scope revision and display unknown booking context explicitly.
Human_Control: Human confirms scope; coordination does not confer signing or trading authority
State_Change: Explicit guarded Product action only; views are read-only
Acceptance_Hypothesis: AC-F01: Given Entity A requests FX forward and Person T works for reported parent B; When working scope is recorded; Then Entity A remains the counterparty and coordination does not grant signing or trading authority.
Product_Behaviour_zh: 产品应保留法人、产品与范围版本，并明确显示未知的 booking 背景。
Human_Control_zh: 人工确认范围；协调资料不授予签署或交易权限。
Acceptance_Hypothesis_zh: AC-F01: 给定主体 A 申请外汇远期且 Person T 任职于申报母公司 B；当记录工作范围时；则主体 A 保持为交易对手，协调资料不会授予签署或交易权限。

Requirement_Title: Make applicable requirements and unresolved applicability explicit
Job_to_Be_Done: Make applicable requirements and unresolved applicability explicit
Current_Problem: Opaque applicability can cause unnecessary requests or missed requirements
Product_Behaviour: The product shall version requirements for the current scope and retain unknown applicability until an explicit reviewed decision.
Human_Control: Human confirms the requirement set; unknown applicability is unresolved
State_Change: Explicit guarded Product action only; views are read-only
Acceptance_Hypothesis: AC-F02: Given applicability is unknown; When the requirement set is presented; Then unknown remains explicit and cannot satisfy readiness or become not_required.
Product_Behaviour_zh: 产品应按当前范围保存要求版本，并保留未知适用性，直到记录明确的复核决定。
Human_Control_zh: 人工确认要求集；未知适用性仍待解决。
Acceptance_Hypothesis_zh: AC-F02: 给定适用性未知；当显示要求集时；则未知保持明确，不得满足就绪条件，也不得变为不适用。

Requirement_Title: Reuse evidence only for a reviewed purpose and current version
Job_to_Be_Done: Reuse evidence only for a reviewed purpose and current version
Current_Problem: A file can support one fact but not a different evidence use
Product_Behaviour: The product shall separate artifact receipt from purpose-specific sufficiency and retain prior claims, assessments and versions.
Human_Control: Reviewer records purpose-specific sufficiency with reason; receipt is not acceptance
State_Change: Explicit guarded Product action only; views are read-only
Acceptance_Hypothesis: AC-F03: Given an artifact is received and its purpose assessment is insufficient; When the case is reevaluated; Then the linked requirement stays unsatisfied and file presence alone cannot make the case ready.
Product_Behaviour_zh: 产品应区分资料收取与特定用途的充分性，并保留先前声明、评估和版本。
Human_Control_zh: 复核人员须记录用途充分性及理由；收到资料不等于接受证据。
Acceptance_Hypothesis_zh: AC-F03: 给定已收到资料但其用途评估仍不充分；当重新评估案件时；则关联要求保持未满足，不能仅因文件存在而就绪。

Requirement_Title: Request only residual facts from permitted contributors
Job_to_Be_Done: Request only residual facts from permitted contributors
Current_Problem: Broad requests and uncontrolled disclosure can expose unrelated data
Product_Behaviour: The product shall show a contributor only explicitly granted request items and preserve partial submission and independent review status.
Human_Control: Request review, dispatch, authentication, grant and business authority are separate
State_Change: Explicit guarded Product action only; views are read-only
Acceptance_Hypothesis: AC-F04: Given two request items have separate contributor grants; When one contributor submits one item; Then only its receipt changes and the other item and overall clearance stay unresolved.
Product_Behaviour_zh: 产品应仅向贡献者显示明确获授权的请求项目，并保留部分提交及独立复核状态。
Human_Control_zh: 请求复核、派发、认证、访问授权和业务代表权限分别判断。
Acceptance_Hypothesis_zh: AC-F04: 给定两个请求项目分别授权给不同贡献者；当一人提交一个项目时；则仅该项目的收取状态变化，另一项目与整体准入仍未解决。

Requirement_Title: Review the right population and distinguish possible matches
Job_to_Be_Done: Review the right population and distinguish possible matches
Current_Problem: Wrong subject or missing coverage can produce false reassurance
Product_Behaviour: The product shall bind runs and findings to a scoped population and preserve unknown coverage and EDD applicability independently.
Human_Control: Specialist makes disposition; EDD applicability has its own reviewed basis
State_Change: Explicit guarded Product action only; views are read-only
Acceptance_Hypothesis: AC-F05: Given population scope is empty, stale or unconfirmed; When screening or readiness is evaluated; Then coverage is not complete and the case cannot become ready.
Product_Behaviour_zh: 产品应将筛查运行与发现关联到限定范围的群体，并分别保留未知覆盖与 EDD 适用性。
Human_Control_zh: 专业人员作出处置；EDD 适用性需独立复核依据。
Acceptance_Hypothesis_zh: AC-F05: 给定筛查群体为空、过时或未经确认；当评估筛查或就绪时；则不得视为覆盖完整，案件不能因此就绪。

Requirement_Title: Continue permitted preparation while exposing scoped waits
Job_to_Be_Done: Continue permitted preparation while exposing scoped waits
Current_Problem: Unversioned handoffs can leave Legal using old Credit inputs
Product_Behaviour: The product shall show the current Credit condition and the exact revision consumed by Legal while allowing only independently permitted preparation.
Human_Control: Specialists own decisions; preparation, approval and execution stay separate
State_Change: Explicit guarded Product action only; views are read-only
Acceptance_Hypothesis: AC-F06: Given a Credit input changes after Legal consumed it; When Legal is reviewed; Then its consumed version is visibly stale and execution/readiness remains blocked until reviewed.
Product_Behaviour_zh: 产品应显示当前信贷条件以及法务实际使用的具体版本，仅允许具备独立前提的准备工作。
Human_Control_zh: 专业人员负责决定；准备、批准和签署分别记录。
Acceptance_Hypothesis_zh: AC-F06: 给定法务采用信贷输入后该输入发生变化；当复核法务状态时；则明确标记所用版本过时，在复核前阻止签署与就绪。

Requirement_Title: Make accountable decisions explicit and scope-bound
Job_to_Be_Done: Make accountable decisions explicit and scope-bound
Current_Problem: Task completion can be mistaken for an authorised decision
Product_Behaviour: The product shall require current scoped readiness, configured authority and an explicit human confirmation before recording clearance.
Human_Control: Only configured synthetic authority can confirm; actual bank authority remains unknown
State_Change: Explicit guarded Product action only; views are read-only
Acceptance_Hypothesis: AC-F07: Given readiness is ready for authorised confirmation and no decision is recorded; When QA, RM or an unknown role attempts confirmation; Then the action is rejected and no clearance decision is created.
Product_Behaviour_zh: 产品应在记录准入前，要求当前限定范围的就绪依据、已配置权限及明确人工确认。
Human_Control_zh: 仅已配置的合成权限可以确认；真实银行权限仍未知。
Acceptance_Hypothesis_zh: AC-F07: 给定已就绪等待获授权确认但尚未记录决定；当 QA、客户经理或未知角色尝试确认时；则拒绝该操作，且不生成准入决定。

Requirement_Title: Explain affected, unaffected and unresolved work
Job_to_Be_Done: Explain affected, unaffected and unresolved work
Current_Problem: Blanket rework or missed dependencies obscures impact
Product_Behaviour: The product shall identify exact affected requirements, evidence uses and downstream dependencies without declaring unmodelled work independent.
Human_Control: Hold owner and release basis must be explicit; absence of an edge is not independence
State_Change: Explicit guarded Product action only; views are read-only
Acceptance_Hypothesis: AC-F08: Given a branch hold with explicit current dependencies; When impact is projected; Then affected work is identified, unrelated work requires an explicit permitted basis, and unknown dependencies remain unknown.
Product_Behaviour_zh: 产品应识别具体受影响要求、证据用途及下游依赖，不将未建模工作声明为独立。
Human_Control_zh: 暂停责任人与解除依据必须明确；缺少依赖边不证明独立。
Acceptance_Hypothesis_zh: AC-F08: 给定条线暂停和明确的当前依赖；当显示影响时；则标明受影响工作，无关工作须有明确获准依据，未知依赖保持未知。

Requirement_Title: Keep readiness, authorised confirmation and publication separate
Job_to_Be_Done: Keep readiness, authorised confirmation and publication separate
Current_Problem: Aggregated green statuses can hide missing basis or failed publication
Product_Behaviour: The product shall evaluate all current applicable prerequisites and retain a clearance decision when a separate publication attempt fails.
Human_Control: QA signs off separately; authorised reviewer confirms; publication is a separate simulated action
State_Change: Explicit guarded Product action only; views are read-only
Acceptance_Hypothesis: AC-F09: Given all applicable prerequisites are satisfied without an authorised decision; When readiness is evaluated; Then it is READY_FOR_AUTHORISED_CONFIRMATION, not CLEARED_TO_TRADE; after an authorised decision a publication failure retains that decision and executes no trade.
Product_Behaviour_zh: 产品应评估全部当前适用前提；独立发布尝试失败时仍保留准入决定。
Human_Control_zh: QA 单独签核，获授权复核人员确认；发布为另一个模拟操作。
Acceptance_Hypothesis_zh: AC-F09: 给定全部适用前提已满足但尚无获授权决定；当评估就绪时；则为 READY_FOR_AUTHORISED_CONFIRMATION，不能为 CLEARED_TO_TRADE。明确确认后如发布失败，应保留决定且不执行交易。

Requirement_Title: Explain outcomes and return to saved work without rewriting history
Job_to_Be_Done: Explain outcomes and return to saved work without rewriting history
Current_Problem: A presentation or stale return can obscure provenance or saved work
Product_Behaviour: The product shall preserve the current saved revision and semantic location across Story, Product, Return, language, print and optional Lab views.
Human_Control: Source support is not bank approval; optional Lab reads only and no injection is enabled
State_Change: Explicit guarded Product action only; views are read-only
Acceptance_Hypothesis: AC-F10: Given saved work at a scene and viewport; When Product returns after language change or Story/graph/Lab/print is used; Then the latest language and saved revision remain and no view control records a business decision.
Product_Behaviour_zh: 产品应在故事、产品、返回、语言、打印及可选 Lab 视角间保留当前保存版本与语义位置。
Human_Control_zh: 来源支持不等于银行批准；可选 Lab 只读，不启用注入。
Acceptance_Hypothesis_zh: AC-F10: 给定某场景与视野中已有保存工作；当更改语言后从产品返回，或使用故事、图示、Lab、打印时；则保留最新语言和保存版本，视图控件不会记录业务决定。
